question: Which Indian state has the largest reserves of Bauxite as per Indian Minerals Yearbook 2017?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook 2017, Odisha has the largest reserves of bauxite in India
 
• Odisha has 51% of the country's bauxite resources
 
• Andhra Pradesh has 16% of the country's bauxite resources
 
• Gujarat has 9% of the country's bauxite resources
 
• Jharkhand has 6% of the country's bauxite resources
 
• Maharashtra has 5% of the country's bauxite resources
 
• Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh
 
 
• Each has 4% of the country's bauxite resources 
 
 
 
• Odisha also has the highest percentage of chromite, manganese, iron ore, and coal in the country
